name: Goliath
summary: A towering Philistine champion from Gath, who for forty days dared Israel to send a man to fight him. The young David killed him with a sling and a stone.

key_moments.title: Defying the Armies of Israel
key_moments.description: Goliath of Gath, wearing armour of brass, came out from the Philistine camp in the valley of Elah. Each day for forty days he dared Israel to send a man against him, and Saul and all Israel were afraid.

key_moments.title: Struck Down by a Stone
key_moments.description: Goliath mocked David and cursed him by his gods. David answered that he came in the LORD's name, then slung a stone into his forehead and cut off his head with his own sword.
